reviews.title: They will charge you even if you cancel
reviews.text:
I signed up specifically to use the free subscription/trial to try the app, and I only used the app once during the free trial period. After deciding I did not want to continue using the app, I canceled the subscription on my end.
I understood the offer to be a free trial, and I did not intend to continue with a paid subscription. I also canceled before I wanted any ongoing subscription charges. Because I only signed up to try the app during the advertised free period and canceled like the app said I could without getting charged. I was wrongfully charged and Apple refused to refund the subscription charge.

reviews.title: I like it - update
reviews.text:
But, Everytime opening it I get the two pop-ups to subscribe and the other for a Christmas offer? Christmas is long gone. Overall, it’s okay. The Speech Recognition option, I like but don’t like, the app worked with it once when I didn’t turn it on, then several minutes later the app wouldn’t work if I had that option off. I don’t hate the Speech Recognition because it would make the AI listen to what I talk about but, when I turn it on, Apple apparently wants me too allow them access to my voice to improve, Speech Recognition? I’m not sure once I used, Speech Recognition, that Apple now has my voice in their database for the Speech Recognition. It’s not on your end, it Apple. Though, I would like to access this app if I could have that off if I wanted to? I feel like this has helped me a bit and I’m glad you don’t have any of our data recorded while using the app.

Update: Not what it used to be.
